roles.use_summary: Names ComBat_seq for cross-laboratory transcriptome batch adjustment. The paper attributes it to DESeq2 and describes transformed/z-scored data; the actual function is supplied by sva and expects counts.
roles.remaining_scope: Do not run ComBat_seq on the described VST/z-scores or reinterpret them as counts. Actual author input units, namespace, package version and command remain unresolved. This is a recovered named use, not a qualified analysis.

roles.use_summary: Uses ComBat from sva 3.46.0 to remove collection-site effects from continuous variance-stabilized gene and isoform expression in the adult brain reference panel.
roles.remaining_scope: HCP 200 gene/175 isoform factors and age, age-squared, sex and genotype-PC removal are later separate adjustments. Exact ComBat flags/design and complete author inputs remain unresolved; neither HCP nor this package mention establishes SVA factor estimation.

roles.use_summary: Uses longitudinal ComBat to harmonize repeated hippocampal volumes while preserving age, sex, race/ethnicity and diagnostic status.
roles.remaining_scope: The cited Beer et al. longitudinal model uses subject dependence and differs from ordinary cross-sectional ComBat. Exact author package/commit, subject/time/random-effect specification and other settings are unknown. Existing continuous native ComBat does not qualify this operation.

roles.use_summary: Uses surrogate-variable adjustment in RNA-seq. The linked author script calls svaseq on DESeq2-normalized counts with a genotype full model and intercept-only null model, then includes SV covariates in differential expression.
roles.remaining_scope: Author package version, full inputs and complete executable recipe are unresolved. Normalized counts for svaseq are distinct from raw counts required by ComBat_seq. The author script has no license declaration in the inspected tree and was read only, never executed or redistributed. Generic Java SVA and its random number generator are not asserted equivalent.
